obfuscation_indicators: adjusted results excluding charges and tax benefits
risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified, reporting sales declines, margin compression, cash generation, liquidity, and inventory changes. Risk is elevated by weaker comparable sales, store traffic slowdown, margin pressure, and planned investment during an uncertain environment, although liquidity and operating cash flow provide support. Adjusted metrics and extensive forward-looking caveats somewhat soften the presentation of underlying performance.
